items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: Howard was trumpet player, you see.

ctx.x: So it was Archie, Darnell, ah, this boy, the drummer, I called his name, he played the drums, named -- the drummer, George Lewis, drummer.
Yeah, he had the same name, Joe Howard, was it?
No, no. Not Howard, the drummer --
